$comment: Single source of truth for the layer boundaries. Read by eslint.config.js (lint time) and by tests/architecture.test.ts (test time) so the rule is defined once and enforced twice.

rules.message: packages/core is the business logic layer: it may not import a web framework, an ORM, a database driver, a mail client, or any layer above it. It depends only on the port interfaces it declares itself.
The presentation layer contains no SQL and never touches the ORM or driver directly. Use a repository from @tasks/data.
The scheduler drives business logic directly. It must not reach the database through the ORM itself, nor call the web application's HTTP API.
